scope: Two frozen source-specific instruments, nominal phase-locked cavity and classical ready/dead detector memory; at most three steps

execution_modes.model: Exact source-model replay; inputs and count words are fixtures
execution_modes.physical: Blocked until all named authority/calibration/protocol slots have reviewed evidence

record_schema.identity: Retain unique occurrence record IDs, trial ordering and predecessor links; equal outcomes do not identify histories
record_schema.no_record_deletion: No-click, vacuum recovery and loss accounting remain in complete records
record_schema.physical_state: Full instrument state, not inferred from a single record
record_schema.predictive_state: Source-conditioned amplitude estimate or probability distribution, carrying parameter/preparation provenance
record_schema.observable: Explicit instrument projection or outcome word with its likelihood

interfaces.state: Returning complex field x at the start of a round trip
interfaces.input: (u,v2,w) in the same energy-normalized port frame; p=q=1 nominal
interfaces.preparation: Declare x0 and all incoming ports; inserting a new x between steps is a separate preparation, not free state reset
interfaces.control: Open-loop specified input sequence; feedback requires a separate well-posedness and actuator contract
interfaces.instrument: Ordered four-port mirror/mirror/loss map of the frozen charter
interfaces.observed_record: Phase-referenced y_r,y_t and independent environment accounting; x_next is an internal state, not a measured output by assertion
interfaces.observer: With known incident u and calibrated mirror coefficients, x=(y_r+r1*u)/t1. Darkness alone does not imply zero state; scalar state remains one-sample observable at t1!=0.
interfaces.units: Amplitudes share an independently fixed nonzero reference; physical energy scale and round-trip T are separate calibration inputs

interfaces.state: Physical ready/dead memory and optical zero/one input; memory is not a posterior probability
interfaces.input: n in {0,1} prepared before each bin without changing memory
interfaces.preparation: Physical ready initialization between trials requires a certified reset event; within-trial prepare(n) acts only on the optical input
interfaces.control: Prespecified photon/vacuum probes; grant of probe capability is a separate physical authorization
interfaces.instrument: For belief mass (R,D): click maps to (0,eta*n*R); no-click maps to ((1-eta*n)*R+gamma*D,(1-gamma)*D)
interfaces.observed_record: C or N for every bin, together with n, ordering and preparation/clock/calibration versions
interfaces.state_update: Use unnormalized outcome maps for likelihood; normalize only for a positive-probability outcome
interfaces.resource_type: photon number and readiness probability as distinct quantities
interfaces.resource_law: Every supplied photon is destroyed: n=registered_count+uncounted_absorbed, with zero surviving optical photons. For an empty bin, dead probability D becomes (1-gamma)D. Readiness recovery is not an energy ledger.
interfaces.observer: p(C)=eta*n*r; r_after_N=((1-eta*n)*r+gamma*(1-r))/(1-eta*n*r); r_after_C=0 on its positive-likelihood domain
interfaces.units: Counts are dimensionless; bin duration, photon frequency/energy, detector bias/recovery power and heat ledger are separately supplied

interval_filter.scope: Fixed eta,gamma independently supplied; prior readiness interval and positive-likelihood record
interval_filter.no_click_monotonicity: Derivative with respect to r is (1-eta*n)*(1-gamma)/(1-eta*n*r)^2 >= 0
interval_filter.rule: Transport interval endpoints through the no-click update only where the likelihood is positive throughout; otherwise flag support restriction rather than invent a posterior

comparison_boundary: Amplitude records and photon/count records have distinct types. No cavity-to-detector routing, Born/quantization map, Poisson approximation or common-source identification is supplied by this interface.
